Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your detailed cost breakdown, together with the approval limits discussed in our reviews, suggests that an internally defensible adjustment matters as much as the price itself. We want to recognise justified cost pressure and maintain a sustainable partnership within your offer’s validity. How can we use payment flexibility to reach an agreement within your approval authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (CU-NOTATION 20%, LCI-C 20%, PPI-C241 14%) and the latest six-month index moves (CU-NOTATION +16.0% (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7% (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06), PPI-C241 +6.2% (idx:PPI-C241@2026-02, idx:PPI-C241@2026-08)), your cost increase comes to about +4.4% of the price, not +6.5%. That supports a price of about EUR 363.67. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We have reviewed your calculations based on six-month index movements; however, our pricing must reflect the full twelve-month cost pressure we have absorbed. Extending payment terms to 90 days increases our financing costs, which would necessitate a higher unit price rather than a reduction. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We submit our current Angebot at a price of €374.84 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

To support our partnership, we can offer a revised price of €370.71, provided we maintain the standard 30-day payment terms. This alternative package offers a price of €370.71 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel, which represents our standard terms.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your concession is tied to payment timing, and Credit Control reinforces that point—it sounds like financing costs are central to your flexibility. We want a fair, sustainable agreement that respects the cost pressure you have absorbed and supports our long-term partnership. How could we balance price and payment timing within what you are authorised to approve?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +4.4%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your slight adjustment in price, but extended payment terms of 90 days carry substantial financing costs that we must price in. 

Our offer stands at a price of €374.64 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

To balance price and payment timing as requested, we can offer a more favourable unit price of €370.51 in exchange for returning to our standard 30-day payment terms, structured as a price of €370.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at our standard terms.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please provide the underlying data or forecasts to substantiate your volume confirmation of 6,110 units.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your concession for faster payment, reinforced by Credit Control’s note, suggests that financing costs are central to your flexibility. We want a sustainable agreement that recognises those costs and supports our long-standing partnership, with verified demand data rather than requests for your internal calculation. How can that demand evidence help you secure approval for a further price adjustment?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +4.4%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.80 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €374.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We are prepared to offer a further concession to €373.85 per unit for the requested 90-day payment term. Our current offer stands at a price of €373.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
